setting: Contemporary late 20th–early 21st century, small-town/suburban Christian social environment: church-centered community norms around marriage and singlehood, quiet middle-class domestic life, and expectations placed on women who remain unmarried into middle age.
spiritual_theme: From misguided patience and spiritualized fear to repentance and active trust — recognizing that fear was mistaken for God’s will, asking forgiveness, and choosing to begin living (obedient surrender to life rather than passive waiting).
emotional_palette: Start with quiet pride and stoic resignation, shifting to aching loneliness and longing, then sharp sting of exclusion and self-questioning; move into confrontation and gentle rebuke, followed by cleansing, weeping and confession; then slow, humble resolve, tentative hope, and finally peaceful joy and liberated contentment.
